title: Live viewer COONS_RECONSTRUCTION + COONS_DELTA shader modes
description: PATCH-33 shipped headless Coons reconstruction multiview PNGs but the live viewer modes weren't wired. Adding them requires either (a) keeping two runtimes alive (original mesh + reconstruction mesh) and switching draw call by ShaderMode, or (b) reuploading mesh data to the existing runtime when toggling, accepting that tag/overlay state resets. Either way ~150 LOC of viewer-side plumbing in MeshNodeViewerScene + HalfEdgeMeshRuntime. COONS_DELTA additionally needs a per-vertex displacement attribute fed to a new shader, which is more invasive.
definition-of-done: Shift+P cycles include COONS_RECONSTRUCTION (renders the sampled Coons surface from CoonsPatchSampler instead of the original mesh) and COONS_DELTA (renders the original mesh with vertices displaced along normal by coonsError × scale). Both modes work on the live skull viewer with no NPE / freeze / black screen. Patch-id colours carry through. Non-4-sided cells render desaturated grey in COONS_RECONSTRUCTION.
testing-plan: 1) Launch mesh-viewer, load skull, P to decompose, Shift+P cycle through new modes. 2) Inspect at least 3 worst-error cells; reconstruction surface should look spiky there (matching the headless render). 3) Toggle back to LAMBERT; original mesh should re-render correctly with no leaked state. 4) Cycle 5+ times to confirm stability.
